name: IWS-225WB
title: IWS-225WB In-Wall Network Streamer
description: In-wall network audio streamer with 2x25W amplifier. Spotify, AirPlay, Bluetooth support.
detailDescription: The IWS-225WB is a high-performance single-gang in-wall WiFi network streamer with built-in Bluetooth, 2x1 digital switch, and integrated stereo amplifier delivering 2x25W per channel. Supports Spotify, Tidal, AirPlay, and more for multi-room audio.

specifications.value: Spotify, Tidal, Deezer, Qobuz, AirPlay, Pandora, Amazon Music

features: Compatible with all Pragmatic PHA speakers
Built-in Bluetooth receiver and 2x1 digital switch
Multi-room synchronized playback or independent per-room
Supports Spotify Connect, AirPlay, DLNA, UPnP
Simple operation with WiiM, 4Stream, AudioCast apps
Minimal installation labor for upgrading legacy systems
applications: Flat screen TV audio with Bluetooth
